global_numerical_semantics.bar_index_semantics: For a signal evaluated after completed row i, next-bar entry is row i+1 open. A fixed H-hour hold exits at row i+1+H open. No same-row-close fill is allowed.
global_numerical_semantics.reference_windows: All rolling threshold/reference distributions exclude the current candidate observation and use only fully formed prior observations. Feature values at decision row i may use row i because that bar is completed. Partial rolling windows are forbidden.
global_numerical_semantics.quantile_definition: Deterministic linear type-7 empirical quantile: sort n finite values, h=(n-1)*p, interpolate linearly between floor(h) and ceil(h).
global_numerical_semantics.median_definition: The p=0.5 instance of the frozen type-7 quantile.
global_numerical_semantics.true_range_definition: max(high-low, abs(high-prev_close), abs(low-prev_close)) on a completed bar.
global_numerical_semantics.return_definition: Simple arithmetic return, price_exit/price_entry-1; no log-return substitution.
global_numerical_semantics.finite_data_rule: Non-finite price/volume/derived values are never coerced. A globally invalid certified dataset fails closed; a mathematically undefined timestamp such as zero variance or zero range cannot signal.
global_numerical_semantics.partition_rule: Training and validation may use earlier PIT rows for lookback state, but a scored trade must have signal, entry and exit market values entirely inside its scored development partition. Protected rows dated 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z or later are never decoded/read.
global_numerical_semantics.cost_semantics: The frozen 24/48/72 bps totals are round-trip drag per trade, applied after each trade's internally gross-notional-normalized gross return and before the fixed 1/3-NAV portfolio slot. Multi-leg trades use total absolute leg notional only inside Trade.gross_return normalization; gross_notional never becomes a cross-trade or future-cluster portfolio weight.
global_numerical_semantics.independence_accounting: Execution follows each candidate's frozen per-asset overlap rule. For statistical independence only, completed trades whose [entry,exit) exposure intervals overlap across any assets/legs of the same candidate are one connected independent-event cluster. Clustering never changes entry-time portfolio sizing. Raw trade count is diagnostic only and never satisfies minimum-independent-trade gates.
global_numerical_semantics.independent_event_return: Each admitted trade receives a fixed 1/3 NAV gross portfolio slot at its own entry; unused slots remain cash and later overlapping signals cannot resize earlier trades. A trade's net return is its already internally gross-notional-normalized gross return minus the frozen round-trip cost. Connected-cluster economic return is sum((1/3) * trade_net_return) across constituent trades, with no normalization by final cluster size or gross_notional. This chronological cluster return is the unit for economic gates, winner/tail tests and profit factor.
global_numerical_semantics.profit_factor_definition: sum(positive independent-event net returns)/abs(sum(negative independent-event net returns)); if there are gains and no losses PF=+infinity; if there are no gains PF=0.
global_numerical_semantics.three_x_gate: Mean 72-bps after-cost independent-event return must be strictly positive in both training and validation.
global_numerical_semantics.validation_half_gate: Mean 24-bps after-cost independent-event return must be strictly positive in each frozen validation half. Half-specific evidence requires every constituent trade's signal, entry and exit timestamps to be fully contained inside the same frozen half. A trade/cluster crossing a half boundary is excluded from half-specific means but remains eligible for overall validation only if every constituent trade stays inside the broader validation partition.
global_numerical_semantics.single_winner_dependence_veto: At 24-bps cost, remove the single best independent event separately in training and validation; the remaining mean must stay strictly positive in each partition.
global_numerical_semantics.catastrophic_tail_veto: At 24-bps cost, the absolute worst independent-event loss must be <= 50% of the sum of all positive independent-event returns, separately in training and validation. No positive-return pool means automatic failure.
global_numerical_semantics.base_economic_gate: At 24-bps cost, mean independent-event return must be >0 and profit factor >1 separately in training and validation.
global_numerical_semantics.status_rule: A data-contract failure is DATA_INCONCLUSIVE. Otherwise insufficient independent-event counts are INCONCLUSIVE_POWER without threshold rescue. Otherwise any failed frozen economic/robustness gate is FAIL. PASS requires every frozen Stage-1 gate. No status grants OOS, forward, promotion or trading authority.

DISC-RESIDUAL-REV-001-v1.beta: OLS slope with intercept-equivalent demeaning: covariance(follower,BTC)/variance(BTC) over exactly 336 completed hourly close-to-close returns ending at decision row i.
DISC-RESIDUAL-REV-001-v1.correlation: Pearson correlation over the same 336 return pairs; gate is correlation >=0.60, not absolute correlation.
DISC-RESIDUAL-REV-001-v1.residual: follower 6h simple return ending at i minus beta_i * BTC 6h simple return ending at i.
DISC-RESIDUAL-REV-001-v1.zscore_reference: Current residual is standardized against exactly 720 prior PIT residual observations. Each historical residual must use its own contemporaneous 336h beta; never recompute history with beta_i. Reference excludes current residual.
DISC-RESIDUAL-REV-001-v1.execution: Let s=-sign(current_residual). Follower leg notional/sign is s*1.0; BTC leg signed notional is -s*beta_i. Freeze beta_i through exit. Gross committed notional is 1+abs(beta_i). Portfolio gross return is signed leg P&L divided by that gross notional.
DISC-RESIDUAL-REV-001-v1.simultaneous_followers: ETH and SOL may both execute per the frozen per-follower overlap rule; overlapping exposure is clustered for independent-event accounting.

DISC-SIGNED-VOLUME-DRIFT-001-v1.signed_volume: For each completed bar j, sign(close_j-open_j) * quote_volume_j / median(prior 720 completed quote_volume bars before j). Zero candle body contributes zero.
DISC-SIGNED-VOLUME-DRIFT-001-v1.aggregate: Sum the four PIT-normalized signed-volume values ending at decision row i. Zero aggregate means no signal.
DISC-SIGNED-VOLUME-DRIFT-001-v1.direction_consistency: At least 3 of the 4 candle-body signs must equal sign(aggregate). Zero-body candles do not count as matching either direction.
DISC-SIGNED-VOLUME-DRIFT-001-v1.pressure_reference: Compare abs(current four-bar aggregate) with the type-7 90th percentile of exactly 720 prior completed four-bar absolute aggregates, each formed PIT.
DISC-SIGNED-VOLUME-DRIFT-001-v1.close_location: (close-low)/(high-low) on decision bar; zero range means no signal. Positive aggregate requires >=0.80; negative aggregate requires <=0.20.
DISC-SIGNED-VOLUME-DRIFT-001-v1.range_guard: Current true range <= type-7 90th percentile of exactly 720 prior completed true ranges.

DISC-LOWVOL-DRIFT-REV-001-v1.move_reference: abs(current 8h move) >= type-7 80th percentile of exactly 720 prior completed absolute 8h moves.
DISC-LOWVOL-DRIFT-REV-001-v1.participation: Arithmetic mean quote volume of the 8 completed bars ending at i <=0.60 * median of exactly 720 prior completed hourly quote volumes before i.
DISC-LOWVOL-DRIFT-REV-001-v1.shock_exclusion: Maximum true range across the 8 completed bars ending at i < type-7 70th percentile of exactly 720 prior completed hourly true ranges before i.
DISC-LOWVOL-DRIFT-REV-001-v1.direction: Opposite sign of the frozen 8h move; zero move cannot signal.

DISC-WEEKEND-NORMALIZE-001-v1.weekend_return: Sunday 23:00 UTC completed-row close / Friday 22:00 UTC completed-row close - 1.
DISC-WEEKEND-NORMALIZE-001-v1.weekend_volume_window: Hourly quote-volume bars strictly after the Friday 22:00 close through and including the Sunday 23:00 completed bar.
DISC-WEEKEND-NORMALIZE-001-v1.prior_20_weekdays: The 20 distinct UTC Monday-Friday calendar dates immediately preceding that Friday date; use all 24 completed hourly bars on each such date, with no weekend hours.
DISC-WEEKEND-NORMALIZE-001-v1.participation: Median weekend-window hourly quote volume <=0.80 * median hourly quote volume across the frozen prior-20-weekday pool.
DISC-WEEKEND-NORMALIZE-001-v1.entry_exit: If abs(weekend_return)>=1.25% and participation passes, enter at Monday 00:00 UTC row open in the opposite direction and exit at Monday 12:00 UTC row open.
DISC-WEEKEND-NORMALIZE-001-v1.power: If minimum independent-event counts are not met, status is INCONCLUSIVE_POWER. Never widen the calendar window, lower the move threshold or add post-hoc weeks.

DISC-MODERATEVOL-AUTOCORR-001-v1.direction_gate: The three hourly close-to-close simple returns ending at i are all strictly >0 or all strictly <0.
DISC-MODERATEVOL-AUTOCORR-001-v1.realized_volatility: Population standard deviation of exactly 24 hourly close-to-close returns ending at i; no annualization.
DISC-MODERATEVOL-AUTOCORR-001-v1.vol_reference: Current 24h realized volatility must lie inclusively between type-7 35th and 70th percentiles of exactly 2160 prior PIT 24h realized-volatility observations.
DISC-MODERATEVOL-AUTOCORR-001-v1.participation: Current quote_volume must lie inclusively between type-7 40th and 90th percentiles of exactly 720 prior completed quote-volume bars.
DISC-MODERATEVOL-AUTOCORR-001-v1.direction: Same sign as the three hourly returns.

DISC-RANGE-AUCTION-REV-001-v1.prior_range: Use highs/lows from exactly rows i-48 through i-1; current row i is excluded. Zero prior-range width means no signal.
DISC-RANGE-AUCTION-REV-001-v1.range_position: (close_i-prior_low)/(prior_high-prior_low), allowed outside [0,1]. Short if >=0.90; long if <=0.10.
DISC-RANGE-AUCTION-REV-001-v1.efficiency_ratio: abs(close_i-close_(i-24)) / sum(abs(close_k-close_(k-1)) for k=i-23..i). Zero denominator means no signal.
DISC-RANGE-AUCTION-REV-001-v1.volume_guard: Current quote_volume <= type-7 60th percentile of exactly 720 prior completed quote-volume bars.
DISC-RANGE-AUCTION-REV-001-v1.atr14: Simple arithmetic mean of true range over exactly 14 completed bars ending at decision row i; freeze this ATR through the trade.
DISC-RANGE-AUCTION-REV-001-v1.stop_anchor: Actual next-bar entry open. Long stop threshold=entry_open-ATR14_i; short stop threshold=entry_open+ATR14_i.
DISC-RANGE-AUCTION-REV-001-v1.exit_precedence: After entry, inspect each completed bar causally. A close reaching/crossing the frozen midpoint triggers next-bar-open exit. An intrabar high/low breaching the frozen stop threshold also triggers next-bar-open exit. If both trigger on one bar, the next-bar-open fill is identical; record BOTH reason flags. Otherwise exit at the row-open exactly 6 hours after entry.
